'''Jeff Boerger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Seattle tournament]] on 15 January 2000 with Bespin Clouds, according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-seattle-washington-1-15-00d177/ seattle-washington-1-15-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 16 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-16-seattle-washington-1-15-00d177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
